options.general.title: Language & appearance
options.general.subtitle: The language and colors of AI Exporter.
options.language.title: Language
options.language.desc: Used for AI Exporter's buttons, menus and messages.
options.language.help: Changes the language of the AI Exporter popup and this page. It doesn't translate your chats or the exported files.
options.language.tip: “Automatic” uses the same language as your browser.
options.theme.title: Colors
options.theme.desc: A light or dark look for AI Exporter.
options.theme.help: Changes the colors of the AI Exporter popup and this page. Your exported files always look the same.
options.theme.tip: “Automatic” follows your computer: when it switches to dark mode, AI Exporter does too.
options.saving.title: Saving files
options.saving.subtitle: Where your exported files go.
options.askWhereToSave.title: Ask where to save each file
options.askWhereToSave.desc: Choose the folder and file name every time you export.
options.askWhereToSave.help: When this is on, a “Save as” window opens for every export, so you can pick the folder and the file name. When it's off, files go straight into your usual download folder.
options.askWhereToSave.tip: Turn it off if you always want your files in the same folder, with no extra clicks.
options.downloadFolder.title: Download folder
options.downloadFolder.desc: Change where files go when AI Exporter doesn't ask.
options.downloadFolder.help: Opens your browser's download settings, where you can choose the folder that downloaded files are saved to, for example your Desktop.
options.downloadFolder.tip: Only the browser can change this folder, so this button takes you straight to the right place.
options.content.title: Chat contents
options.content.subtitle: What your exported chats include and how they are laid out.
options.images.title: Include pictures
options.images.desc: Save the pictures from the chat together with the text.
options.images.help: PDF files show the pictures right inside the document. Other file types with pictures are downloaded as a ZIP folder holding the chat file and an “images” folder. When this is off, only the text is saved.
options.images.tip: After unzipping, keep the chat file and the “images” folder together, or the pictures won't show. Copying a chat always copies the text only.
options.timestamp.title: Date and time of export
options.timestamp.desc: Write when the chat was exported at the top of the file.
options.timestamp.help: Adds a line with the date and time of the export to the top of PDF, Markdown and text files, and of copied chats.
options.timestamp.tip: Handy if you save the same chat more than once and want to know which copy is the newest.
options.headings.title: Names above messages
options.headings.desc: Show who wrote each message: you or the AI.
options.headings.help: Writes “User” above your messages and “Assistant” above the AI's answers, so it's easy to see who said what. In Markdown files they become a heading (## User) or a bold name (**User:**).
options.headings.tip: In PDF files, “Heading” and “Bold name” look the same. Only “No names” makes a difference there.
options.spacing.title: Space between messages
options.spacing.desc: How messages are separated from each other.
options.spacing.help: Puts a small gap, a bigger gap or a dividing line between messages in Markdown and text files, and in copied chats.
options.spacing.tip: “Dividing line” also draws a thin line between messages in PDF files.
options.pdf.title: PDF documents
options.pdf.subtitle: Only used when you export a chat as a PDF.
options.fontSize.title: Text size
options.fontSize.desc: How big the letters are, in points (pt).
options.fontSize.help: Sets the size of the normal text in the PDF. Titles and code grow or shrink along with it. 11 pt is a common size for documents.
options.fontSize.tip: Choose 13 or 14 for text that's easier to read, especially on paper. Smaller text fits more on each page.
options.pageFormat.title: Paper size
options.pageFormat.help: Pick the paper you print on, so nothing gets cut off or shrunk when you print.
options.pageFormat.tip: A4 is the standard in Europe and most of the world. Letter and Legal are used in the USA and Canada.
options.orientation.title: Page direction
options.orientation.help: Portrait pages are tall, like a letter. Landscape pages are wide, like a TV screen.
options.orientation.tip: Landscape gives wide tables and long lines of code more room.
options.margins.title: Margins
options.margins.desc: The empty space around the edges of each page, in millimeters.
options.margins.help: The blank border between the text and the edge of the paper. The little page shows how yours will look. 10 mm is 1 cm.
options.margins.tip: Page numbers and your own text are printed inside the bottom margin, so keep it at 10 mm or more when you use them. Most printers can't print closer than 5 mm to the edge.
options.pageNumbers.title: Page numbers
options.pageNumbers.desc: Number every page at the bottom.
options.pageNumbers.help: Prints the page number and the total, like “3 / 12”, in the bottom right corner of every page.
options.pageNumbers.tip: Very helpful if you print a long chat and the pages get mixed up.
options.toc.title: Table of contents
options.toc.desc: A list of all messages at the start of the PDF.
options.toc.help: Adds a numbered list of every message, with the page it starts on, at the beginning of the PDF. Click an entry to jump straight to that message.
options.toc.tip: Useful for long chats. For a short chat it just adds an extra page.
options.footerText.title: Your own text on every page
options.footerText.desc: A short line at the bottom of every page, such as your name.
options.footerText.help: Prints your own text in the bottom left corner of every page, for example your name, your company or “Confidential”.
options.footerText.tip: Keep it short, so it fits on one line next to the page number.
options.footerText.label: Text to print
options.github.title: GitHub
options.github.subtitle: Optional and meant for programmers. Most people can skip this.
options.github.help: GitHub is a website where people keep code and files. Once you connect it, the GitHub button in the Export window saves the chat into one of your repositories (project folders).
options.github.tip: You don't need this to download files. You can disconnect at any time.
